flagged.comment: Site is subject to Compatibility Standards (MF-2 zoning within 75 feet of adjacent SF-3 parcel). The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9 addresses general lighting shielding per Subchapter E 2.5 but does not specifically address vehicle light screening from parking lots/structures. Under LDC § 25-2-1063(E)(1), vehicle lights from vehicles using or parked on a parking lot or in a parking structure must be screened from the property line or alleyway shared with the triggering property. This requirement must be demonstrated on the site plan with specific shielding details or clarifying notes.
areas: Parking lot and parking structure areas

EHZ analysis per DCM Appendix E Level 1 procedure must be submitted if triggering criteria are met.
